purpose.title: 2. Purpose of the Application
purpose.content:
Nomli is a social network application for nomadic travelers. It allows users to:
- Locate and connect with other users
- Share trips and travel journals
- Request and offer help to the community
- Participate in community events

data.title: 3. Personal Data
data.content:
Personal data collected is processed in accordance with GDPR. You have the right to access, rectify and delete your data.

Data collected:
- Profile information (name, photo)
- Geographic location (with consent)
- Messages and shared content
- Connection data

Your data is never sold to third parties.

liability.title: 4. Liability
liability.content:
The publisher cannot be held responsible for:
- Content published by users
- Meetings organized via the application
- Direct or indirect damages related to the use of the application

Users are responsible for their interactions and must exercise caution.

modifications.content: The publisher reserves the right to modify this legal notice at any time. Users will be informed of any substantial changes.

law.content: This legal notice is governed by French law. Any dispute will be submitted to the competent French courts.
